messages:
priya: Heads-up — onboarding flow in the sampleapp broke. Traced it to a parity gap: the Python SDK doesn't expose the admin models list we use to show variant details.

lee: which admin path are you calling?

priya: `/admin/models/list` with org key. curl returns quantProfiles + costTier + supported_hardware. SDK's `client.models.list()` only returns public fields. UI falls back to a generic selector.

jon: also noticed param mismatch: REST admin filter wants `model_version` but SDK sends `modelVersion`. Server ignores unknown keys for admin routes and returns defaults — so the UI silently chose the latest. Bad onboarding UX.

rachel: silent defaults are a big footgun. Can we make the server return 400 for unknown admin filters or at least log a warning?

lee: short term we should add admin.list_models() to the Python SDK and accept both `model_version` and `modelVersion`. I'll take the SDK change.

priya: thanks. I can push a sampleapp patch that calls the admin REST directly as a stopgap and include a repro in the PR.

jon: adding tests: sampleapp e2e should fail if admin metadata (quantProfiles, costTier) is missing. Also add a test that camelCase still works.

rachel: FYI I observed another minor difference: SDK stream mode batches deltas more aggressively than raw REST stream, which made our onboarding progress bar jumpy. Not blocking but worth noting in release notes.

devex-bot: Created issue RDW-4750: "python-sdk: add admin models list + param aliasing; investigate stream chunking" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4750

lee: plan: open SDK PR today, include types and a param normalizer for known admin filters. Will document migration notes.

priya: I'll open the sampleapp PR with screenshots and curl vs SDK snippets.

jon: platform team — can you add server-side validation for admin filters in RDW-4750 or link a follow-up?

rachel: noted. Also recommend we add a small onboarding warning in the app if the model selector returns the default set. Saves users confusion.

priya: agreed. I'll add that to the sampleapp PR. Will ping here when PRs are up.

lee: thanks everyone. Temporary workaround: call the admin REST endpoint directly with the org key until the SDK patch ships.

priya: thanks — will do.
